Bava Batra 20b:16-21a:12: Gemara may shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: sefa atan lechatzer acheret. amar leh rava: i hachi, litne: chatzer acheret – muttar! ella amar rava:
Sefa atan letinokot shel bet rabban, umittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach –

Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: beram, zachur oto haish lattov – vihoshua ben gamla shemo, sheilmale hu, nishtakkach tora miyyisrael. shebbitchilla, mi sheyyesh lo av – melammedo tora, mi sheen lo av – lo haya lamed tora. may derush? "velimmadtem otam" – velimmadtem attem.

Hitkinu sheyyehu moshivin melammede tinokot birushalayim. may derush? "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora". vaadayin mi sheyyesh lo av – haya maalo umelammedo, mi sheen lo av – lo haya ole velamed. hitkinu sheyyehu moshivin bechol pelech ufelech. umachnisin otan keven shesh esre keven sheva esre,

Umi shehaya rabbo koes alav – mevaet bo veyotze. ad shebba yehoshua ben gamla vetikken, sheyyehu moshivin melammede tinokot bechol medina umedina uvechol ir vair, umachnisin otan keven shesh keven sheva.

Amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: ad shet la tekabbel, mikkan veelach – kabbel, veaspi leh ketora. vaamar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: ki machet leyanoka, la timche ella bearketa dimsana. dekare – kare, dela kare – leheve tzavvta lechavreh.
Metivi: echad mibbene chatzer shebbikkesh leasot rofe, umman, vegardi, umelammed tinokot – bene chatzer meakkevin alav! hacha bemay askinan – betinokot degoyim.
Ta shema: shenayim sheyyoshvin bechatzer, uvikkesh echad mehen leasot rofe, veumman, vegardi, umelammed tinokot – chavero meakkev alav! hacha name betinokot degoyim.
Ta shema: mi sheyyesh lo bayit bachatzar hashshuttafin – hare ze lo yaskirennu lo lerofe, velo leumman, velo legardi, velo lesofer yehudi, velo lesofer armay! hacha bemay askinan – besofer mata.

Amar rava: mittakkanat yehoshua ben gamla veelach, la mamtinan yanoka mimmata lemata; aval mibbe chenishta leve chenishta – mamtinan. vei mafsek nahara – la mamtinan. vei ikka tittura – mamtinan. vei ikka gamla – la mamtinan.
Veamar rava: sach makre dardeke – esrin vechamsha yanoke. vei ikka chamshin – motvinan tere; vei ikka arbein – mokminan resh duchena, umesayyeyin leh mimmata.

Veamar rava: hay makre yanoke degares, veikka acharina degares tefe minneh – la mesallekinan leh, dilma ate leitrashshole. rav dimi minnehardea amar: kol shekken degares tefe – kinat sofrim tarbe chachma.

Veamar rava: hane tere makre dardeke – chad gares vela dayek, vechad dayek vela gares – motvinan hahu degares vela dayek; shabbeshta mimmela nafka. rav dimi minnehardea amar: motvinan dedayek vela gares; shabbeshta, kevan deal – al;
Berakhot 15b:27-16a:6: Tane rav ovadya kammeh derava: "velimmadtem" sheyyehe limmudecha tam — sheyyitten revach ben haddevakim.
Ane rava batreh: kegon "al levavecha", "al levavchem", "bechol levavcha", "bechol levavchem", "esev besadcha", "vaavadtem mehera", "hakkanaf petil", "etchem meeretz".

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: kol hakkore keriat shema umedakdek beotiyyoteha metzannenin lo gehinnam, shenneemar: "befares shadday melachim bah tashleg betzalmon" — al tikre "befares" ella "befaresh", al tikre "betzalmon" ella "betzalmavet".
Veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: lamma nismechu

Ohalim linchalim, dichtiv: "kinchalim nittayu kegannot ale nahar kaahalim nata vegomer" — lomar lecha: ma nechalim maalin et haadam mittumea letohora — af ohalim maalin et haadam mikkaf chova lechaf zechut.

Rabbi amme verabbi assi havo ka katrin leh genana lerabbi elazar. amar lehu: addehachi vehachi ezil veeshma milleta deve midresha, veete veema lechu. azal ashkecheh letanna dekatane kammeh derabbi yochanan:
Kara vetaa veeno yodea lehechan taa, beemtza happerek — yachzor larosh. ben perek leferek — yachzor leferek rishon. ben ketiva lichtiva — yachzor lichtiva rishona.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem", aval patach bilmaan yirbu yemechem" — sircheh naket veate.
Ata vaamar lehu. amaru leh: illu lo banu ella lishmoa davar ze — dayyenu.
I Kings 7:13-18: Vayyishlach hammelech shelomo vayyikkach et-chiram mitztzor

Vayyatzar et-shene haammudim nechoshet shemone esre amma komat haammud haechad vechut shetem-esre amma yasov et-haammud hashsheni
Ushete chotarot asa latet al-rashe haammudim mutzak nechoshet chamesh ammot komat hakkoteret haechat vechamesh ammot komat hakkoteret hashshenit

Ketubot 67a:13-67b:7: Tanu rabbanan: yatom vitoma shebbau lehitparnes — mefarnesin et hayyetoma veachar kach mefarnesin et hayyatom, mippene shehaish darko lachzor al happetachim, veen ishsha darkah lachzor. yatom vitoma
Shebbau linnase — massiin et hayyetoma veachar kach massiin et hayyatom, mippene shebboshtah shel ishsha merubba mishshel ish.

Tanu rabbanan: yatom shebba lissa — sochrin lo bayit, umatztziin lo mitta vechol kele tashmisho, veachar kach massiin lo ishsha, shenneemar: "de machsoro asher yechsar lo". "de machsoro" — ze habbayit, "asher yechsar" — ze mitta veshulchan, "lo" — zo ishsha. vechen hu omer: "eese lo ezer kenegdo".

Tanu rabbanan: "de machsoro" — atta metzuvvev alav lefarneso, vei atta metzuvvev alav leashshero. "asher yechsar lo" — afillu sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav. amru alav al hillel hazzaken shellakach leani ben tovim echad sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav. paam achat lo matza eved larutz lefanav, veratz lefanav shelosha milin.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beanshe galil haelyon shellakchu leani ben tovim echad mitztzippori litra basar bechol yom. litra basar may revuta? amar rav huna: litra basar mishshel ofot. veibbaet ema belitra, basar mammash. rav ashe amar: hatam kefar katan haya, bechol yoma hava mafsedi chevta ammetuleteh.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi nechemya, amar leh: bamma atta soed? amar leh bevasar shamen veyayin yashan. retzoncha shettegalgel immi baadashim? gilgel immo baadashim vamet. amar: oy lo leze sheharago nechemya. adderabba, "oy lo linchemya sheharago leze" mibbee leh! ella: ihu hu dela ibbei leh lefannoke nafsheh kulle hay.

Hahu daata lekammeh derava, amar lo: bamma atta soed? amar lo: betarnegolet petuma veyayin yashan. amar leh: vela chayyshat leducheka detzibbura? amar leh: attu middidhu kaachelna? midderachmana kaachelna! detanena: "ene chol elecha yesabberu veatta noten lahem et ochlam beitto". "beittam" lo neemar, ella "beitto" — melammed shekkol echad veechad noten hakkadosh baruch hu parnasato beitto.
Addehachi, atay achateh derava dela chazya leh telesre shene, veatya leh tarnegolet petuma veyayin yashan. amar: may dekamma? amar leh: naaneti lecha, kum echol.
Menachot 29b:6-13: Amar rava: shevao otiyyot tzerichot shelosha ziyyunin, veellu hen: 436 93. amar rav ashe: chazena lehu lesafre davvkane deve rav, dechatri lehu legaggeh dechet, vetalu leh lechareh dehe.

Chotri lehu legaggeh dechet, kelomar: chay hu berumo shel olam, vetalu leh lechareh dehe, kediva minneh rabbi yehuda nesia merabbi amme: may dichtiv "bitchu bayya ade ad ki beyah Adonai tzor olamim"? amar leh: kol hattole bitchono behakkadosh baruch hu hare lo machse baolam hazze velaolam habba.
Amar leh: ana hachi ka kashya li, may shena dichtiv "beyah" vela ketiv "yah"?

Kiddaresh rabbi yehuda bar rabbi ilay: ellu shene olamot shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu, echad behe veechad beYod, veeni yodea im haolam habba beYod vehaolam hazze behe, im haolam hazze beYod vehaolam habba behe.
Keshehu omer: "elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram", al tikre "behibbaram" ella: behe beraam.
Umippene ma nivra haolam hazze behe? mippene sheddome leachsadra, shekkol harotze latzet yetze. umay tama talya kareh? dei hadar bitshuva meayyeyli leh.

Veliayyel behach, la mistayyeya milleta, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen"? ba littaher – mesayyeyin oto, ba littamme – potchin lo. umay tama it leh taga? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: im chozer – ani kosher lo kesher.
Mippene ma nivra haolam habba beYod? mippene shetztzaddikim shebbo muatim. umippene ma kafuf rosho? mippene shetztzaddikim shebbo kafuf rashehem mippene maasehen, sheenan domin ze laze.
Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:6-5:1:
Shor shehaya mitchakkech bechotel venafal al haadam, nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, lenachri veharag et yisrael, linfalim veharag ben keyama, patur: 
Shor haishsha, shor hayetomim, shor haappotroppos, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshim, hare ellu chayyavim mita. rabbi yehuda omer, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet, peturim min hammita, lefi sheen lahem bealim: 
Shor shehu yotze lehissakel vehikdisho vealav, eno mukdash. shechato, besaro asur. veim ad shello nigmar dino hikdisho vealav, mukdash. veim shechato, besaro muttar: 
Mesaro leshomer chinnam, uleshoel, lenose sachar, ulesocher, nichnesu tachat habbealim, muad meshallem nezek shalem, vetam meshallem chatzi nezek. kesharo vealav bemosera, venaal befanav karauy, veyatza vehizzik, echad tam veechad muad chayyav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, tam chayyav umuad patur, shenneemar (Shemot 21) velo yishmerennu bealav, veshamur hu ze. rabbi eliezer omer, en lo shemira ella sakkin: 
Shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello negachah yalda, im mishshennegachah yalda, meshallem chatzi nezek lappara urevia nezek lavvalad. vechen para shennagcha et hashshor venimtza veladah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda, im mishshennagcha yalda, meshallem chatzi nezek min happara urevia nezek min havvalad:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:2-5:
Hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, veshibberatan behemto shel baal habbayit, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal hakkederot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut, baal chatzer chayyav. hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal happerot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut, baal hechatzer chayyav: 
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit, o shenneshacho chalbo shel baal habbayit, patur. nagach hu shoro shel baal habbayit, chayyav. nafal levoro vehivish memav, chayyav. haya aviv o veno letocho, meshallem et hakkofer. veim hichnis birshut, baal hechatzer chayyav. rabbi omer, bechullan eno chayyav, ad sheyyekabbel alav lishmor: 
Shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha, patur middeme veladot. veadam shehaya mitkavven lachavero vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha, meshallem deme veladot. ketzad meshallem deme veladot, shamin et haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalda vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, im ken, mishshehaishsha yoledet, mashbachat. ella shamin et havveladot kamma hen yafin, venoten labbaal. veim en lah baal, noten leyorshav. hayta shifcha venishtachrera, o giyyoret, patur: 
Hachofer bor birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut harabbim, o virshut harabbim ufetacho lirshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut hayyachid acher, chayyav. hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, chayyav. echad hachofer bor, shiach umeara, charitzin uneitzin, chayyav. im ken, lamma neemar bor, ma bor sheyyesh bo chede lehamit, asara tefachim, af kol sheyyesh bo chede lehamit, asara tefachim. hayu fechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, patur. veim huzzak bo, chayyav:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:6-6:2:
Bor shel shene shuttafin, avar alav harishon velo chissahu, vehashsheni velo chissahu, hashsheni chayyav. kissahu harishon, uva hashsheni umetzao megulle velo chissahu, hashsheni chayyav. kissahu charauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, patur. lo chissahu charauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, chayyav. nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya, chayyav. leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya, patur. nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu, chamor vechelav venitkaru, chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim. nafal letocho shor cheresh, shote vekatan, chayyav. ben o vat, eved o ama, patur: 
Echad shor veechad kol behema linfilat habbor, ulehafrashat har sinay, uletashlume chefel, velahashavat aveda, lifrika, lachasima, lechilayim, uleshabbat. vechen chayya vaof kayyotze vahen. im ken, lamma neemar shor o chamor. ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove: 
Hakkones tzon laddir, venaal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika, patur. lo naal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika, chayyav. nifretza vallayla o shepperatzuha listim, veyatza vehizzika, patur. hotziuha listim, listim chayyavim: 
Hinnichah bachamma, o shemmesarah lecheresh, shote vekatan, veyatza vehizzika, chayyav. mesarah leroe, nichnas roe tachtav. nafla leginna venehenet, meshallemet ma shennehenet. yarda chedarkah vehizzika, meshallemet ma shehizzika. ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika, shamin bet sea beota sade, kamma hayta yafa vechamma hi yafa. rabbi shimon omer, achla perot gemurim meshallemet perot gemurim. im sea sea, im satayim satayim:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:3-6:
Hammagdish betoch sade shel chavero shello virshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal haggadish chayyav. veim higdish birshut, baal hassade chayyav: 
Hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh, shote vekatan, patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. shalach beyad pikkeach, happikkeach chayyav. echad hevi et haur, veechad hevi et haetzim, hammevi et haetzim chayyav. echad hevi et haetzim, veechad hevi et haur, hammevi et haur chayyav. ba acher velibba, hammelabbe chayyav. libbeta haruach, kullan peturin. hashsholeach et habbeera veachla etzim, o avanim, o afar, chayyav, shenneemar (Shemot 22) ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade, shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera. avra gader shehu gavoah arba ammot, o derech harabbim, o nahar, patur. hammadlik betoch shello, ad kamma taavor haddeleka. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, roin oto keilu hu veemtza bet kor. rabbi eliezer omer, shesh esre ammot, kederech reshut harabbim. rabbi akiva omer, chamishshim amma. rabbi shimon omer, shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera (Shemot 22), hakkol lefi haddeleka: 
Hammadlik et haggadish, vehayu bo chelim vedalaku. rabbi yehuda omer, yeshallem ma shebbetocho. vachachamim omrim, eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o shel seorim. haya gedi chafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo, chayyav. eved kafut lo ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo, patur. umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira, shehu meshallem kol ma shebbetocho, shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim: 
Getz sheyyatza mittachat happattish vehizzik, chayyav. gamal shehaya taun pishtan veavar birshut harabbim, venichnas pishtano letoch hachanut, vedalku benero shel chenvani vehidlik et habbira, baal haggamal chayyav. hinniach chenvani nero mibbachutz, hachenvani chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, bener chanukka patur:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 7:1-5: Merubba middat tashlume chefel mimmiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget ben bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uven bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella beshor vase bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 21) ki yignov ish shor o se utevacho o mecharo vegomer. en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel, velo hattoveach velo hammocher achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha:

Ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihem o al pi shenayim acherim, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav umachar beshabbat, ganav umachar laavoda zara, ganav vetavach beyom hakkippurim, ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar veachar kach met aviv, ganav vetavach veachar kach hikdish, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav vetavach lirfua o lichlavim, hashshochet venimtza terefa, hashshochet chullin baazara, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu:

Ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihem, venimtzeu zommin, meshallemin hakkol. ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pi shenayim acherim, ellu veellu nimtzeu zommin, harishonim meshallemim tashlume chefel, vehaacharonim meshallemin tashlume shelosha. nimtzeu acharonim zommin, hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha. echad min haacharonim zomem, batla edut sheniyya. echad min harishonim zomem, batla kol haedut, sheim en geneva en tevicha veen mechira:

Ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pi ed echad, o al pi atzmo, meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav vetavach beshabbat, ganav vetavach laavoda zara, ganav mishshel aviv, umet aviv, veachar kach tavach umachar, ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shechayyav beacharayutam, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. sheen chayyav beacharayutam, patur:

Mecharo chutz meechad mimmea shebbo, o shehayta lo vo shuttafut, hashshochet venitnabbela veyado, hannocher, vehameakker, meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav birshut habbealim vetavach umachar chutz mershutam, o shegganav chutz mershutam vetavach umachar birshutam, o shegganav vetavach umachar chutz mershutam, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. aval ganav vetavach umachar birshutam, patur:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 7:6-8:2: Haya moshcho veyotze, umet birshut habbealim, patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim, umet, chayyav. netano livchorot beno o levaal chovo, leshomer chinnam, uleshoel, lenose sachar, ulesocher, vehaya moshcho, umet birshut habbealim, patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim, umet, chayyav:

En megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael, aval megaddelin besureya, uvammidbarot shebbeeretz yisrael. en megaddelin tarnegolim birushalayim, mippene hakkadashim, velo chohanim beeretz yisrael, mippene hattohorot. en megaddelin chazirim bechol makom. lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev, ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet. en porsin nishbim layyonim. ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris:

Hachovel bachavero chayyav alav mishshum chamishsha devarim, benezek, betzaar, berippuy, beshevet, uvevoshet. benezek ketzad. simma et eno, kata et yado, shibber et raglo, roin oto keillu hu eved nimkar bashshuk veshamin kamma haya yafe vechamma hu yafe. tzaar, kevao veshappud o vemasmer, vaafillu al tzipparno, mekom sheeno ose chabbura, omdin kamma adam kayyotze vaze rotze littol lihyot mitztaer kach. rippuy, hikkahu chayyav lerappeoto. alu vo tzemachim, im mechamat hammakka, chayyav. shello mechamat hammakka, patur. chayta venistera, chayta venistera, chayyav lerappeoto. chayta chol tzarkah, eno chayyav lerappeoto. shevet, roin oto keilu hu shomer kishshuin, shekkevar natan lo deme yado udeme raglo. boshet, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. hamevayyesh et hearom, hamevayyesh et hassuma, vehamevayyesh et hayyashen, chayyav. veyashen shebbiyyesh, patur. nafal min haggag, vehizzik uviyyesh, chayyav al hannezek ufatur al habboshet, shenneemar (Devarim 25) veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav, eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyhe mitkavven:
Ze chomer baadam mibbashshor, shehaadam meshallem nezek, tzaar, rippuy, shevet, uvoshet, umeshallem deme veladot, veshor eno meshallem ella nezek, ufatur middeme veladot:
Mishnah Challah 1:1-4:
Chamishsha devarim chayyavim bachalla, hachittim vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshifon. hare ellu chayyavin bachalla, umitztarfin ze im ze, vaasurin bechadash millifne happesach, umilliktzor millifne haomer. veim hishrishu kodem laomer, haomer mattiran. veim lav, asurin ad sheyyavo haomer habba: 
Haochel mehem kazzayit matztza befesach, yatza yede chovato. kazzayit chametz, chayyav behikkaret. nitarev echad mehem bechol hamminim, hare ze over befesach. hannoder min happat umin hattevua, asur bahem, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hannoder min haddagan eno asur ella mehen. vechayyavin bachalla uvammaasrot: 
Ellu chayyavin bachalla ufeturim min hammaasrot. halleket, vehashshichcha, vehappea, vehahefker, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, umotar haomer, utevua shello hevia shelish. rabbi eliezer omer, tevua shello hevia shelish, petura min hachalla: 
Ellu chayyavin bammaasrot ufeturim min hachalla, haorez, vehaddochan, vehapperagim, vehashshumshemin, vehakkitniyyot, ufachot mechameshet revaim battevua. hassufganin, vehadduvshanin, vehaiskeritin, vechallat hammasret, vehamedumma, peturin min hachalla:
Mishnah Challah 1:5-9:
Issa shettechillatah sufganin vesofah sufganin, petura min hachalla. techillatah issa vesofah sufganin, techillatah sufganin vesofah issa, chayyavin bachalla. vechen hakkenuvekaot chayyavot: 
Hammeissa, bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyevin. hachalita, bet shammay mechayyevin, uvet hillel potrin. challot toda urekike nazir, asaan leatzmo, patur. limkor bashshuk, chayyav: 
Nachtom sheasa seor lechallek, chayyav bachalla. nashim shennatnu lenachtom laasot lahen seor, im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur, petura min hachalla: 
Issat hakkelavim, bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna, chayyevet bachalla, umearvin bah, umishtattefin bah, umevarchin aleha, umezammenin aleha, venaaset beyom tov, veyotze vah adam yede chovato befesach. im en haroim ochlin mimmenna, enah chayyevet bachalla, veen mearvin bah, veen mishtattefin bah, veen mevarchin aleha, veen mezammenin aleha, veenah naaset beyom tov, veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach. ben kach uven kach, mittammea tumat ochalin: 
Hachalla vehatteruma, chayyavin aleha mita vechomesh, vaasurim lezarim, vehem nichse chohen, veolin beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh, veen nittalin min hattahor al hattame, ella min hammukkaf umin haddavar haggamur. haomer, kol garni teruma vechol issati challa, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyeshayyer miktzat:
Mishnah Challah 2:1-4: Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz, chayyavim bachalla. yatzu mikkan lesham, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, verabbi akiva poter:

Afar chutza laaretz shebba visfina laaretz, chayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehassefina gosheshet. issa shennillosha veme ferot, chayyevet bachalla, veneechelet beyadayim mesoavot:

Haishsha yoshevet vekotza challatah arumma, mippene shehi yechola lechassot atzmah, aval lo haish. mi sheeno yachol laasot issato vetohora, yaasenna kabbin, veal yaasenna vetuma. verabbi akiva omer, yaasenna vetuma veal yaasenna kabbim, shekkeshem shehu kore lattehora, kach hu kore lattemea, lezo kore challa vashshem ulezo kore challa vashshem, aval kabbim en lahem chelek bashshem:
Haose issato kabbim venagu ze vaze, peturim min hachalla ad sheyyishshochu. rabbi eliezer omer, af harode venoten lassal, hassal metzarfan lachalla:
Mishnah Challah 2:5-8: Hammafrish challato kemach, enah challa, vegazel beyad kohen. haissa atzmah, chayyevet bachalla. vehakkemach, im yesh bo chashshiur, chayyevet bachalla, vaasura lezarim, divre rabbi yehoshua. amru lo, maase ukefashah zaken zar. amar lahem, af hu kilkel leatzmo vetikken laacherim:
Chameshet revaim kemach, chayyavim bachalla. hem useoran vesubban umursanan chameshet revaim, chayyavin. nittal mursanan mittochan vechazar letochan, hare ellu feturin:

Shiur hachalla, echad meesrim vearbaa. haose issa leatzmo, vehaose lemishte veno, echad meesrim vearbaa. nachtom shehu ose limkor bashshuk, vechen haishsha shehi osa limkor bashshuk, echad mearbaim ushemona. nitmet issatah shogeget o anusa, echad mearbaim ushemona. nitmet mezida, echad meesrim vearbaa, kede shello yehe chote niskar:

Rabbi eliezer omer, nittelet min hattahor al hattame. ketzad, issa tehora veissa temea, notel kede challa meissa shello huram challatah, venoten pachot mikkabbetza baemtza, kede sheyyittol min hammukkaf. vachachamim osrin:
Mishnah Challah 3:1-4:
Ochlin aray min haissa, ad shettitgalgel bachittim vetittamtem basseorim. gilgelah bachittim vetimtemah basseorim, haochel mimmenna chayyav mita. kevan shehi notenet et hammayim, magbahat challatah, uvilvad shello yehe sham chamishsha rive kemach: 
Nidmea issatah ad shello gilgela, petura, shehammedumma patur. umishsheggilgela, chayyevet. nolad lah sefek tuma ad shello gilgela, tease vetuma, umishsheggilgela, tease vetohora: 
Hikdisha issatah ad shello gilgela, ufedaattah, chayyevet. mishsheggilgela, ufedaatta, chayyevet. hikdishattah ad shello gilgela, vegilgelah haggizbar, veachar kach pedaattah, petura, shebbishat chovatah hayta fetura: 
Kayyotze vo, hammakdish perotav ad shello vau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. umishshebbau leonat hammaasrot, ufedaan, chayyavin. hikdishan ad shello nigmeru, ugemaran haggizbar, veachar kach pedaan, peturin, shebbishat chovatan hayu feturin:
Mishnah Challah 3:5-9:
Nachri shennatan leyisrael laasot lo issa, petura min hachalla. netanah lo mattana, ad shello gilgel, chayyav, umishsheggilgel, patur. haose issa im hannachri, im en beshel yisrael keshiur challa, petura min hachalla: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo issa, naaset ad shello nitgayyer, patur, umishshennitgayyer, chayyav. veim safek, chayyav, veen chayyavin aleha chomesh. rabbi akiva omer, hakkol holech achar hakkerima vattannur: 
Haose issa min hachittim umin haorez, im yesh bah taam dagan, chayyevet bachalla, veyotze vah adam yede chovato befesach. veim en bah taam dagan, enah chayyevet bachalla, veen adam yotze vah yede chovato befesach: 
Hannotel seor meissa shello hurema challatah venoten letoch issa shehurema challatah, im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher, motzi lefi cheshbon. veim lav, motzi challa achat al hakkol: 
Kayyotze vo, zete masik shennitarvu im zete nikkuf, inneve vatzir im inneve ollot, im yesh lo farnasa mimmakom acher, motzi lefi cheshbon. veim lav, motzi teruma uterumat maaser lakkol, vehashshear maaser umaaser sheni lefi cheshbon:
Mishnah Kelim 18:9-19:3: Mitta shennignav chetzyah, o avad chetzyah, o chalakuha achin, o shuttafin, tehora. hecheziruha, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. mitta mittammea chavila, umittaheret chavila, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mittammea evarim, umittaheret evarim:

Hamefarek et hammitta lehatebilah, vehannogea bachavalin, tahor. hachevel meematay hu chibbur lammitta, mishsheyyesareg bah shelosha vattim. vehannogea min hakkesher velifnim, tame. min hakkesher velachutz, tahor. nime hakkesher, hannogea betzarko, tame. vechamma hu tzarko, rabbi yehuda omer, shalosh etzbaot:
Hachevel hayyotze min hammitta, ad chamishsha tefachim, tahor. mechamishsha vead asara, tame. measara velachutz, tahor, shebbo koshrin et happesachim, umeshalshelin et hammittot:
Mizran hayyotze min hammitta, kol shehu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, ad asara tefachim. sheyare mizran, shiva tefachim, kede laasoto chevek lachamor:
Mishnah Kelim 19:4-7: Nissa hazzav al hammitta veal hammizran, metamme shenayim ufosel echad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, nissa hazzav al hammitta veal hammizran, asara tefachim, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. measara velachutz, metamme echad ufosel echad. nissa al hammizran, measara velifnim, tame. measara velachutz, tahor:

Mitta shehayta temea midras, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea midras. persha, hi temea midras, vehammizran magga midras. hayta temea tumat shiva, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea tumat shiva. persha, hi temea tumat shiva, vehammizran tame tumat arev. hayta temea tumat erev, vecharach lah mizran, kullah temea tumat arev. persha, hi temea tumat erev, vehammizran tahor:

Mitta shekkarach lah mizran, venaga bahen hammet, temein tumat shiva. pershu, temein tumat shiva. naga bahen hashsheretz, temein tumat arev. pershu, temein tumat arev. mitta shennittelu shete arukkot shellah veasa lah chadashot, velo shinna et hannekavim, nishtabberu chadashot, temea. vishanot, tehora, shehakkol holech achar hayeshanot:
Teva sheppitchah milmala, temea teme met. nifchata milmala, temea teme met. nifchata millematta, tehora. megurot shebbah, temeot, veenam chibbur lah:
Mishnah Kelim 19:8-20:2: Hatturemel shennifchata kis shebbetocho, tame, veeno chibbur lo. hachemet shebbetzim shellah mekabbelot immah, venifchatu, tehorot, sheenam mekabbelot kedarkan:

Teva sheppitchah mitztziddah, temea midras uteme met. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman sheenah gevoha asara tefachim, o sheen lah lizbez tefach. nifchata milmalan, temea teme met. nifchata millemattan, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharin, mippene shebbatal haikkar, batla hattefela:
Mishpelet shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharim, mippene shebbatal haikkar, batla hattefela:

Hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin shennifchatu, hare ellu temeim midras. hakkelusetar, arbaa kabbin, hatturemel chameshet kabbin, hakkeretit sea. hachemet shel shivat kabbin, rabbi yehuda omer, af harivtzal vehammizvada kol shehen, hare ellu temein midras. vechullam shennifchatu, tehorim, mippene shebbatal haikkar, uvatla hattefela:

Chemet chalilin, tehora min hammidras. arevat pisonot, bet shammay omrim, midras. uvet hillel omrim, teme met. areva mishshene log vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, temea midras. hinnichah baggeshamim venitpecha, temea teme met. bakkadim venisdeka, mekabbelet midras. ze chomer bishyare chele etz mibbitchillatan. vechomer bishyare chele netzarim mibbitchillatan, shemmittechillatan enam mekabbelim tuma ad sheyyitchassemu. nitchassemu, af al pi shennashru siftotehen kol shehen, temein:
Mishnah Kelim 20:3-6: Makkel sheasao bet yad lekurdom, chibbur lattuma bishat melacha. haddeyusetar, chibbur lattuma bishat melacha. kevao vichlonas, tame, veeno chibbur lah. asa lo deyusetar, en tame ella tzarko. kisse shekkevao vichlonas, tame, veeno chibbur lo. asa vo chisse, en tame ella mekomo. kevao vekorat bet habbad, tame, veeno chibbur lah. asa veroshah kisse, tahor, mippene sheomrin lo, amod venaase et melachtenu:
Areva gedola shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim, vehitkinah lishiva, rabbi akiva metamme. vachachamim metaharin, ad sheyyekatztzea. asaah evus labbehema, af al pi shekkevaah bakkotel, temea:

Kofet shekkevao venidbach, kevao velo vana alav, bana alav velo kevao, tame. kevao uvana alav, tahor. mappatz shennetano al gabbe hakkorot, kevao velo natan alav et hammaaziva, natan alav et hammaaziva velo kevao, tame. kevao venatan alav et hammaaziva, tahor. keara shekkevaah beshidda teva umigdal, kederech kabbalatah, temea. shello chederech kabbalatah, tehora:

Sadin shehu teme midras vaasao vilon, tahor min hammidras, aval tame teme met. meematay hi tohorato. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyittaver. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyikkasher. rabbi akiva omer, mishsheyyikkavea:
Mishnah Kelim 20:7-21:3:
Machatzelet sheasa lah kanim learkah, tehora. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyaase chemin chi. asaam lerachbah veen ben kane lachavero arbaa tefachim, tahor. nechleka lerachbah, rabbi yehuda metaher. vechen hammattir rashe hammaadannin, tehora. nechleka learkah venishtayyeru vah shelosha maadannim shel shishsha tefachim, temea. machatzelet, meematay mekabbelet tuma. mishshettikkanev, vehi gemar melachtah:  
Hannogea bakkoved haelyon, bakkoved hattachton, bannirim, uvakkeros, uvechut sheheeviro al gabbe argaman, uveira sheeno atid lehachazirah, tahor. benefesh hammassechet, uvashsheti haomed, uvechaful sheheeviro al gabbe haargaman, uveira shehi atida lehachazirah, tame. hannogea batztzemer sheal haimma, baashvaya, tahor. hannogea bappika, ad shello ferah, tame. mishshepperah, tahor: 
Hannogea baol, uvakkatrav, baayin, uvaavot, afillu vishat melacha, tahor. bacherev, uvabborech, uvayyatzul, tame. baayin shel mattechet, ballechayayin, uvaarayin, tame. rabbi yehuda metaher ballechayayim, sheenam asuyin ella lerabbot et heafar: 
Hannogea beyad megera, mikkan umikkan, tame. bachut, uvammeshicha, baamma, uvassenifin, bammachbesh shel charash, uvakkashtanit, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af hannogea bammalben shel massar haggadol, tahor. hannogea bayyeter uvakkeshet, af al pi shehi metucha, tahor. metzuddat haeshut, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, kol zeman shehi metucha, chibbur:
Mishnah Kelim 22:1-4:
Hashshulchan vehaddelufki shennifchatu, o shechippan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat hakkosot, temeim. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom hannachat chatichot: 
Hashshulchan shennittela achat meraglav, tahor. nittela sheniyya, tahor. nittela hashshelishit, tame kesheyyachshov alav. rabbi yose omer, en tzarich machashava. vechen haddelufki: 
Safsal shennittal achad merashav, tahor. nittal hashsheni, tahor. im yesh bo gova tefach, tame. sherafraf shennittal achad merashav, tame. vechen hakkisse shellifne kattedra: 
Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af malben shel kisse, tame. kisse shekkevao vaareva, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin. shammay omer, af heasuy bah:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Vechen hitkinu sheyyehe adam mitpallel tefilla achat ballayla shehare evre tamid shel ben haarbayim mitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 b)</small> "hi haola" vegomer, kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 55 18)</small> "erev vavoker vetzohorayim asicha veeheme vayyishma koli". veen tefillat arvit chova kitfillat shacharit umincha. veaf al pi chen nahagu kol yisrael bechol mekomot moshvotehem lehitpallel arvit vekibbeluha alehem kitfillat chova:

Vechen tikkenu tefilla achar tefillat mincha samuch lishkiat hachamma beyom hattaanit bilvad kede lehosif techinna uvakkasha mippene hattaanit vezo hi hattefilla hannikret tefillat neila kelomar ninalu shaare shamayim bead hashshemesh venistera, lefi sheen mitpallelin otah ella samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Nimtzeu hattefillot bechol yom shalosh. arvit veshacharit umincha. uvashshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim arba. shalosh shel kol yom utefillat hammusafin. uveyom hakkippurim chamesh. arba ellu utefillat neila:

Tefillot ellu en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. im ratza adam lehitpallel kol hayyom kullo harshut beyado. vechol otan hattefillot sheyyosif kemo makriv nedavot. lefichach tzarich sheyyechaddesh davar bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberachot. veim chiddesh afillu bivracha achat dayyo kede lehodia shehi nedava velo chova. veshalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot leolam en mosifin bahen velo pochatin mehen veen meshannin bahen davar:

En hatztzibbur mitpallelin tefillat nedava lefi sheen hatztzibbur meviin karban nedava. velo yitpallel afillu yachid musaf shetayim achat chovat hayyom veachat nedava lefi sheen mitnaddevin karban musaf. veyesh min haggeonim mi shehora sheasur lehitpallel tefillat nedava beshabbatot veyamim tovim lefi sheen makrivin bahen nedava ella chovat hayyom bilvad:

Vime rabban gamliel rabbu haeppikorosin beyisrael vehayu metzerim leyisrael umesitin otan lashuv meachare hashshem. vechevan sheraa shezzo gedola mikkol tzarche bene adam amad hu uvet dino vehitkin beracha achat shettihye bah sheela millifne hashshem leabbed haeppikorosin vekava otah battefilla kede shettihye arucha befi hakkol. nimtzeu kol habberachot shebbattefilla tesha esre berachot:

Bechol tefilla shebbechol yom mitpallel adam tesha esre berachot ellu al hasseder. bamme devarim amurim keshemmatza dato mechuvvenet uleshono temaher likrot. aval im haya tarud vedachuk o shekkatzra leshono mehitpallel yitpallel shalosh rishonot uveracha achat meen kol haemtzaiyyot veshalosh acharonot veyetze yede chovato:

Vezohi habberacha shettikkenu meen kol haemtzaiyyot. havinenu Adonai elohenu ladaat et derachecha umol et levavenu leyiratcha lesoleach heye lanu lihyot geulim rachakenu mimmachov vedashnenu veshakkenenu binot artzecha unefotzim mearba tekabbetz vehattoim bedatecha yishshaftu veal harshaim tanif yadcha veyismechu tzaddikim bevinyan irecha uvetikkun hechalecha uvitzmichat keren ledavid avdecha uvaarichat ner leven yishshay meshichecha terem nikra atta taane kaddavar shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 65 kad)</small> "vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma" ki atta hu one bechol et pode umatztzil mikkol tzuka baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:

Bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma. aval bimot haggeshamim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat hashshanim. vechen bemotzae shabbatot veyamim tovim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat:

Uveshabbatot uveyamim tovim mitpallel sheva berachot bechol tefilla utefilla mearba tefillot shel oto hayyom. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uveracha emtzait meen oto hayyom. beshabbatot chotmin bivracha emtzait mekaddesh hashshabbat. uvargalim chotem bah mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. veim haya shabbat veyom tov chotmim bah mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim. berosh hashshana chotmin bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron. veim haya shabbat chotem bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hazzikkaron:

Bamme devarim amurim bitfillat arvit veshacharit umincha. aval tefillat hammusafin shel rosh hashshana mitpallel tesha berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot shel kol yom veshalosh emtzaiyyot. rishona min haemtzaiyyot inyanah malchuyyot. sheniyya zichronot. shelishit shofarot. vechotem bechol achat mehen meinyanah:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:16-18: Muttar lehasheil kelim ulehaskiran lenachri veaf al pi shehu ose bahen melacha beshabbat mippene sheen anu metzuvvim al shevitat hakkelim. aval behemto veavdo asur mippene sheanu metzuvvin al shevitat behema veeved:

Hammishtattef im hannachri bimlacha o bischora o bachanut. im hitnu battechilla sheyyihye sechar hashshabbat lannachri levaddo im meat im harebe usechar yom acher keneged yom hashshabbat leyisrael levaddo muttar. veim lo hitnu battechilla. kesheyyavou lachalok notel hannachri sechar hashshabbatot kullan levaddo vehashshear cholkin oto. veeno mosif lo kelum keneged yom hashshabbat ella im ken hitnu battechilla. vechen im kibbelu sade beshuttafut din echad hu:

Veim lo hittenu uvau lachalok hassachar velo haya sechar shabbat yadua yerae li shehannachri notel levaddo sheviit hassachar vehashshear cholkin. hannoten maot lenachri lehitassek bahen af al pi shehannachri nose venoten beshabbat cholek immo bassachar beshave vechen horu kol haggeonim:
Niddah 19b:17-20: Zeeri amar rabbi chanina: kedam maacholet shel rosh. metivi: harga maacholet — hare zo tola bah. may lav dechulleh gufa? la, deresha.
Amme vardinaa, amar rabbi avahu: kedam etzba ketanna shel yad, shenniggefa vechayyta vechazra veniggefa. velo shel kol adam, ella shel bachur shello nasa ishsha. vead kamma? ad ben esrim.
Metivi: tole bivnah uvevalah? bishlama bivnah — mashkachat la, ella balah — hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon shennichnesa lachuppa, velo nivala.
Proverbs 19:22-27: Taavat adam chasdo vetov-rash meish kazav

Letz takke ufeti yarim vehochiach lenavon yavin daat

Proverbs 19:28-20:2: Ed beliyyaal yalitz mishpat ufi reshaim yevalla-aven

Al-teehav shena pen-tivvaresh pekach enecha seva-lachem
Shabbat 145b:10-146a:1: Yatev rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi kammeh derabbi yochanan, veyatev rabbi yochanan veka menamnem. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi assi: mippene ma ofot shebbevavel shemenim? amar leh: kelach lemidbar azza vearech shemenim mehen. mippene ma moadim shebbevavel semechim? mippene shehen aniyyim. mippene ma talmide chachamim shebbevavel metzuyyaynin? lefi sheenan bene tora. mippene ma goyim mezohamim? mippene sheochlin shekatzim uremasim.

Ittear behu rabbi yochanan, amar lehu: dardeke! lo kach amarti lachem: "emor lachochma achoti at" — im barur lecha haddavar kaachotcha shehi asura lecha — omrehu, veim lav — lo tomrehu. amaru leh: velema lan mar eze mehen? mippene ma ofot shebbevavel shemenim — mippene shello galu, shenneemar: "shaanan moav minneurav veshoket hu el shemarav uvaggola lo halach".

Vehacha menalan diglo? detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chamishshim ushetayim shana lo avar ish bihuda, shenneemar: "al heharim essa vechi vanehi vegomer meof hashshamayim vead behema naddu halachu", "behema" begimatriyya chamshin vetarten havu.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: kullan chazru, chutz mikkolyays haispenin, daamar rav: hane midre devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam. vehay, kevan dela sharir shidreh la matze salek.

Mippene ma moadim shebbevavel semechim? — mippene shello hayu beotah kelala, dichtiv: "vehishbatti kol mesosah chaggah chodshah veshabbattah vechol moadah". uchetiv: "chodshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hayu alay latorach". may "hayu alay latorach"? amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo dayyayn leyisrael shechotin lefanay, ella shemmatrichin oti leda ezo gezera kasha avi alehen! amar rabbi yitzchak: en lecha kol regel varegel shello bata boleshet letzippori. veamar rabbi chanina: en lecha kol regel varegel shello ba litverya agmon vekomton uvaal zemora.

Mippene ma talmide chachamim shebbevavel metzuyyaynin? — lefi sheenan bene mekoman. deamri inashe: bemata shemay, bela mata — totvay. "habbaim yashresh yaakov yatzitz ufarach yisrael". tane rav yosef: ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, sheosin tzitzin uferachim lattora.
Mippene ma goyim mezohamin? — shello amdu al har sinay. shebbeshaa

Shebba nachash al chavva hetil bah zuhama, yisrael sheamdu al har sinay — paska zuhamatan, goyim shello amdu al har sinay — lo paska zuhamatan. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: gerim may? amar leh: af al gav deinhu la havo, mazzalayyhu havo. dichtiv: "et asher yeshno po immanu omed hayyom lifne Adonai elohenu veet asher enennu po vegomer".
Zohar, Vayakhel 10: Veta chaze, bechol yoma karoza kare, kol bene alma, bechu kayyayma milla da, veda hu (Shemot 35:5) kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. vei tema dekashya milla alayychu. kol nediv libbo yevieha.

Mahu yevieha. ella mehacha olifna raza litzlota. devar nash dedachil lemareh umechavven libbeh ureuteh bitzlota, atkin tikkuna dilella, kema deukimna. bekadmita beshirin (197 amud alef) vetushebchan, dekaamrin malachin illain leella. uvehahu siddura detushebchan deka amre yisrael letatta, ihi keshitat garmaha, veitattakkanat betikkunaha. keitteta deitkashtat levalah.

Uvesiddura ditzlota, behahu tikkuna ditzlota dimyushav, atkinu ulemtaha vechol innun dilah. umitkashshetan kol innun bahadah, levatar deittakkan kolla veitsedaru, kad matu leemet veyatztziv, keden kolla mettakna, ihi veulemtaha, ad dematu legaal yisrael, keden itzterich lemekam kolla al kiumayyhu.

Begin dechad bar nash mate leemet veyatztziv, vecholla ittakkan. ulemtaha natle lah, veihi netilat garmah legabbe malka illaa. kevan dematu legaal yisrael, keden malka kaddisha illaa natil bedargoy, venafik lekabbela lah.

Vaanan, mikkamme malka illaa bainan lekayyeyma al kiumana, beemata birada. deha keden oshit yemineh legabbah, ulevatar semaleh, deshavve lah techot reshe, ulevatar itchabbeku tarvavyyhu kachada binshiku. veillen innun telat kadmayta, uvae bar nash leshavvava libbeh ureuteh, ulechavvna bechol hane tikkunin vesidurin ditzlota. pumeh velibbeh ureuteh kachada.

Hasheta demalka illaa umatronita innun bechibbura bechedva beinnun neshikin. man deitzterich lemishal sheeltin, yishal. deha keden shaata diruta ihu. kevan deshail bar nash sheeltoy mikkamme malka umatronita, keden yatkin garmeh biruteh velibbeh litlata acharanin, leatara chedva ditmiru, deha meillen telat itbarcha bidvekuta achara. veyatkin bar nash garmeh lemefak mikkammayyhu, uleannacha lon bechedva geniza deillen telat. veim kol da, dihe reuteh, deyitbarchun tattae, meinnun birkan dechedva temira.

Ucheden itzterich leminpal al anpoy, ulemimsar nafsheh, beshaata deihi nakta nafshin ruchin. keden ihi shaata lemimsar nafsheh bego innun nafshin deihi nakta, deha keden tzerora dechayye ihu kedka yeot.

Milla da shemana berazin devutzina kaddisha, vela ityeyhiv li reshu legallaa, bar lechu chaside elyonin. dei behahi shaata deihi nakta nafshin veruchin biru didvekuta chada, ihu yeshavve libbeh ureuteh leda, veyahiv nafsheh bidvekuta, behahu reuta, leachlela lah behahu devekuta. i itkabbilat behahi shaata behahu reuta, deinnun nafshin ruchin venishmatin deihi nakta. hay ihu bar nash deittzerir bitzrora dechayye behay alma, uvealma deate.

Vetu devaya leitkallela mikkol sitrin, malka umatronita, milella (189 amud alef) umittatta, uleitattera benishmatin bechol sitrin. itatterat benishmatin milella, veitatterat benishmatin mittatta. vei bar nash yechavven libbeh ureuteh lechol da, veyimsor nafsheh mittatta bidvekuta biruta kema deittemar. keden kudesha berich hu kare leh shalom letatta, kegavvna dehahu shalom dilella. hahu devarich lah lematronita veachlil lah veatar lah bechol itrin.

Uf hachi, hay bar nash kudesha berich hu kare leh shalom letatta, kema deat amer (Shoftim 6:24) vayyikra lo Adonai shalom. vechol yomoy hachi karan leh leella, shalom. begin deachlil veatar lematronita letatta, kegavvna dehahu shalom leella.

Vechad istallak hahu bar nash mehay alma, nishmateh salleka uvaka bechol innun rekiin, velet man deyimche bidah. vekudesha berich hu kare lah veamar (Yeshayahu 57:2) yavo shalom. ushechinta amra, yanuchu al mishkevotam vegomer. veyiftechun lah telesar ture deafarsemona dachya, vela yehe man deyimche bidah. veal da, zakkaa ihu man deyshavve libbeh ureuteh leda. veal da ketiv, kol nediv libbo yevieha et terumat Adonai legabbe malka illaa, kema deittemar.

Arim ribbi abba kaleh, veamar, vavy ribbi shimon, ant bachayyin, vaana bachena alach. la alach bachena, ella bachena al chavrayyay, uvachena al alma. ribbi shimon kevutzina dishragga, deadlik leella veadlik letatta. uvinhora deadlik letatta, nehirin kol bene alma, (nusach acher nahir leella) vavy lealma, kad yistalak nehora diltatta binhora dilella. man yanhir nehora deorayyta lealma. kam ribbi abba venashik leribbi chiyyay. amar leh millin illen havo techot yedach, veal da kudesha berich hu shadarni ad hacha, leitchabbera immechon zakkaa chulaki.

Ribbi yose patach kera avatrih veamar, (Shemot 35:10) vechol chacham lev bachem yavou veyyaasu vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, (Devarim 1:13) havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim, ashgach bechol yisrael, vela ashkach nevonim, hada hu dichtiv, vaekkach et rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim, veillu nevonim la ketiv. vei tema denavon ihu darga illaa mechacham, hachi ihu vadday.

Ma ben hay lehay. chacham, ha ukemuha, deafillu talmid hammachkim lerabbeh ikre chacham. chacham, deyada legarmeh kol ma deitzterich. navon kama dargin it beh, deistakkal becholla, veyada bedileh uveacharanin. vesimanich, (Mishlei 12:10) yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto. (Shmuel b 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim. vehacha chacham lev dayyka. ballev chacham, vela beatra achara, begin dekayyeyma ballev, venavon leella vetatta, istakkal bedileh uveacharanin.
Zohar, Vayakhel 39: Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Rut 3:7) vayochal boaz vayyesht vayyitav libbo. mahu vayyitav libbo. devarich al mezoneh, veukemuha. veda hu raza, deman dimvarech al mezoneh, da otiv lelibbeh, uman otiv (nusach acher ihu) kema dichtiv, (tehillim 27 8) lecha amar libbi. uchetiv (Tehillim 73:26) tzor levavi vegomer.

Uvegin devirkat mezona chaviva kamme kudesha berich hu, kol man devarich al sava, otiv vechadde laatar achara, vesimanich seudate deshabbat, deatar achara ithani mehahi beracha (204 amud bet) desava vechidu. vehacha ithane mehahu beracha desava dehahu tzaddik boaz veda vayyitav libbo.

May tama. begin dimzona ihu kashe kamme kudesha berich hu hahu atar, vechevan devar nash achil veshate, veka mevarech. hahi birchata salleka, veithane meinnun millin desava desalkin, veishtechach deithane mimmezona mittatta umilleella.

Veda ihu raza deven chavrayyay. raza bechol la ithane hahu atar, ella meinnun millin desalkin miggo sava, vechullehu millin mitatteran veravvavn vesavin bechedu, vehahu atar ithani minnayyhu. beshabbat ihu raza ochora, bimzona mammash, uvehahu chedva dimzona demitzva deshabbat, uvecholla ishtechach kelila meella vetatta. veraza da (divre hayamim 1 29 14) ki mimmecha hakkol umiyyadcha natannu lach. vadday bahanauteh da, uvehahu chedva dimzona demitzva deshabbat, kema deukemuha.

Man dimvarech lekudesha berich hu miggo sava, bae lechavvevna libbeh, uleshavvava reuteh bechedva, vela yishtekach atziv, ella divarech bechedva beraza da, uleshavvaa reuteh deha ihu yahiv hasheta leachara bechedva, beena tava, uchemma deihu mevarech bechedva uvaena tava. hachi yahavin leh bechedva uvaena tava. ubbegin kach la yishtekach atziv kelal, ella bechedva, uvemillin deorayyta, vishavve libbeh ureuteh lemehav beracha da, beraza deitzterich.

Raza hacha, arba retichin shallitin, bed sitrin umashiryayn, itzanu mehahi birchata desava, uveinnun millin devaruch atta, ithani veitrabbe veitattar beh. uman dimvarech itzterich reuta bechedva, uveena tava, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach.

Vehacha shafil lesefeh dikra, dichtiv ki natan millachmo laddal. dei la tema hachi, hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ella tov ayin, kema deokimna, hu yevarech vadday, beena tava bechedva. velav ihu lemigna levarcha bechedva, deha mehahi birchata, umehahu chedu natan millachmo laddal, atar deitzterich leitzana mikkol sitrin. atar delet leh miggarmeh kelum. atar deithani mikkol sitrin veitkelil mikkol sitrin. millin illen la itmesaru ella lechakkimin deyadin razin illain veorchin deorayyta.

Ta chaze, boaz tav ena hava tukepa demitzcha la hava beh lealma. ma ketiv, (Rut 3:7) vayyavo lishkav biktze haarema, raza dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 7:3) bitnech aremat chittim. mehacha olifna, kol man dimvarech birkat mezona kedka yeot, bechedva biruta delibba, kad salik mehay alma, atar ittakna leh, go razin illain behechalin kaddishin. zakkaa ihu bar nash denatir pikkude demareh, veyada raza dilhon, delet lach pikkuda ufikkuda beorayyta, dela talyayn beh razin illain, unehorin vezivin illain, uvene nasha la yade, vela mashgichin bikara demarehon. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, innun demishtaddele beorayyta zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze deha amru, dechol innun takife mitzcha, delet lehu kissufa, let lehon chulaka bealma den uvealma deate. kol innun takife mitzcha dahavo behu beyisrael, kad havo mistakkelan behahu tzitz, havo mitavran libbayyhu, umistakkelan beovadayyhu. begin detzitz al at hava kaim, vechol man demistakkel beh, hava machsif beovadoy. veal da tzitz mechappera al innun takife anpin, takife mitzcha.

Atvavn deraza dishma kaddisha dahavo gelifin al tzitza, havo naharin uvaltin venatztzin. kol man dehava mistakkal behahu netzitzu deatvavn, anpoy naflin meemata, vahava itbar libbeh, ucheden tzitza mechappera alayyhu. kegavvna da kevan deihu garim letavra libbeh, uleitkannea mikkamme mareh.
Zohar, Vayakhel 41: Patach veamar, (Shemot 37) vayyaas mizbeach miktar ketoret vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, begin ditren madbechin havo, madbecha deillavavn, umadbecha diktoret busemin, da levar, veda lego. hay madbecha diktoret, deihu penimaa, amay ikre mizbeach, veha la davchin beh divchin, umizbeach al da ikre.

Ella begin devatil vechafit lechamma sitrin bishin, uvegin dehahu sitra bisha kefit la yachil leshalletaa, vela lemeheve kattegora, veal da ikre mizbeach. kad hahu sitra bisha hava chame (sefer acher ammuda deushna) ashana diktoret desalik, itkafyay vearak, vela yachil lekarva kelal lemashkena. uvegin da itdache vela itarav behahu chedva dilella, bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, uvegin dechaviva kol kach, la kaim hahu mizbeach, ella (davar acher penimaa) lego. dehay ihu mizbeach devirkan ishtechachu beh, veal da satim meena.

Ma ketiv beaharon, (Bamidbar 17:13) vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggefa, dechafit leh lemalach hammavet, dela yachil leshalletaa kelal, vela lemebad dina. simana da itmesar bidana, di bechol atar dekaamre bechavavna, ureuta delibba ovada diktoret, dela shalta motana behahu atar, vela yitzak, vela yachlin shear ammin leshalletaa al hahu atar.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, mizbeach miktar ketoret. kevan dichtiv mizbeach, amay ikre miktar ketoret. ella begin denatle mehay atar leaktera, kema deavad aharon. tu, mizbeach itzterich leaktera lekaddesha leh behahu ketoret, veal da miktar ketoret. tu, miktar ketoret, ketargumo, leaktera ketoret, deha asir leaktera baatar achara ketoret, bar mimmachta. (nusach acher mimmechitta deyom hakkippurim)

Ta chaze, hay man dedina radif avatreh, itzterich lehay ketoret, uleatava kamme mareh, deha siyyua ihu leistalleka dinin minneh, uvehay vadday mistallekin minneh, i hu ragil behay, leadkera teren zimnin beyoma, betzafra uveramsha, dichtiv ketoret sammim babboker vabboker uchetiv ben haarbayim yaktirenna. veda ihu kiuma dealma tadir, dichtiv, (Shemot 30:8) ketoret tamid lifni Adonai ledorotechem vadday hu kiuma dealma letatta, vekiyyuma dealma leella.

Behahu atar dela idkar bechol yoma ovada diktoret, dinin dilella sharyayn beh, umotanin sagiu beh, veammin acharanin shaltin aleh. begin dichtiv, ketoret tamid lifne Adonai. tamid ihu kayyeyma lifne Adonai, yattir mikkol pulechanin acharanin, chaviva ihu ovada diktoret, dehu yakkir vechaviv kamme kudesha berich hu, yattir mikkol pulechanin ureutin (nusach acher veovadin) dealma. veaf al gav ditzlota ihi mealleyay mikkolla, ovada diktoret hu yakkir vechaviv kame kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, ma ben tzelota leovada diktoret. tzelota atkinu lah baatar dekarbenin, dahavo avde yisrael, vechol innun karbenin dahavo avdin yisrael, lav innun chashivin kiktoret. vetu ma ben hay lehay. ella tzelota ihu tikkuna leatkena ma deitzterich, ketoret avid yattir, metakken vekashir kishrin, veavid nehiru yattir mikkolla. uman ihu deabar zuhama veidke mashkena, vecholla itnehir veittakkan veitkashshar kachada.
Veal da baenan leakdema ovada diktoret litzlota, bechol yoma veyoma, leabera zuhama mealma, deihu tikkuna decholla, bechol yoma veyoma. kegavvna dehahu karbana chaviva deitree beh kudesha berich hu.

Ma ketiv bemoshe (shamevatel) vayyomer Adonai el moshe kach lecha sammim nataf vegomer af al gav deokmuha, aval may shena beovada da yattir mikkol ma deamar leh. ella kach lecha, lahanaatach uletoaltach. begin dechad itteta itdakkeat, hanauta devalah ihu. veraza da kach lecha sammim, leabera zuhama, leitkaddesha itteta bevalah. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Kegavvna da (Vayikra 9:2) kach lecha egel ben bakar, deittemar leaharon. lechappara al choveh, al hahu egel deihu garim lon leyisrael. veal da ketiv bemoshe, kach lecha, lahanaatach, uletoaltach. (sefer acher lechach ukemuha bappasel lecha, mehahu pesolet dalevach avna nitashsher moshe uf hachi lecha lahanaatach uletovatcha)

Ketoret kashir keshiru, nahir nehiru veabar zuhama. ved itchabbar baAdonai (davar acher 4 itavid Adonai), Adonai itchabbar bev. 6 salik veitattar baAdonai. Adonai itnehir bey. vecholla salik reuta leen sof. vahave kolla keshiru chad, veitavid chad keshiru, beraza chada deihu kishra illaa decholla.

Mikkan ulehala, kevan decholla itkashshera behay kishra, itattar kolla beraza deen sof. veraza dishma kaddisha itnehir, veitattar bechol sitrin, vealmin kullehu bechedva. veitnehiru butzinin umezonin uvirkan ishtechachu bechol almin, vecholla beraza diktoret. vei zuhama la itabbar, kolla la itavid. decholla behay talyay.

Ta chaze, ketoret ihu kadmaa tadir, kodam lecholla. ubbegin kach ovada diktoret itzterich leakdema litzlota, leshirin vetushebchan. begin dechol da la salleka, vela ittakkan, vela itkashshar, ad deitavar zuhama, ma ketiv (Vayikra 16:16) vechipper al hakkodesh vegomer bekadmita, ulevatar umippishehem lechol chattotam. veal da baenan lechappera al kudesha, uleabera zuhama, uleitdakkea kudsha. ulevatar shirin vetushebchan utzelotin, kolla kidkaamran.

Zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, deha innun yadin letakkena tikkuna dilella vetatta, kidvaenan letakkena tikkuna mittatta leella ad deitkashshar kolla kachada, bekishshura chad, behahu kitura (sefer acher kishshura) illaa kad baenan letakkena (tikkunin letatta bainan letakkena) betikkuna deatvavn reshimin, dekudesha berich hu itkere behon.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Melech yoshev al kisse din. kefishuto, o yesh lefarsho keneged hakkadosh baruch hu, veyesh lefarsho keneged shofte emet:
targum: Malka deyatev al kuresya dedina mefazer min kadamohi chulhon bishta:

rashi: Nediv libbo. al shem shellibbo nodvo, karuy nediv lev. kevar perashti nidvat hammishkan umelachto bimkom tzavvatan:
ohc: Yevieha et terumat Adonai. pasuk ze mare beetzba ki levad hammuregash yesh hammusekol, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Tikkunim tikun ka) ki maase hatteruma musekol hi bechinat hashshechina, ki lah yikkare terumat Adonai, veal yede maase hatteruma yafil bah davar tov vichabber ohel bal yimmot, veikkar haratzon bammaase hu hammusekol, vehu amro yevieha perush yavi labbechina hanneelemet im terumat Adonai, uveer hakkatuv mi hu asher yevieha, veamar kol nediv libbo, perush, haose davar minnesiut hallev asher yiddevennu letzad hitnoaut haruchanit hashshochen ballev becheshek haddavar yafil bammusekol nelam, aval im yavi hatteruma belo nedivut lev en ze poel bammusekol.

Zahav vachesef vegomer. raiti latet lev bechol happarasha beseder hitchabberut hashshemot uferate haddevarim, ki lo hishva middotav bahem. lifamim yomar vav bechol perat hannosaf, kemaasehu beseder 13 devarim habbaim benidvat hammishkan sheamar vav bechol nosaf, velifamim yomar vav behitchabberut hag, keamro "et hammishkan et oholo veet michsehu", vetechef chazar bo bakkatuv atzmo velakach seder hitchabberut acher veamar "et kerasav veet kerashav", vechen al ze hadderech ad sof seder perate hammishkan, kamma shinnuyim bifrat ze.

Venire leyashshev behakedim divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 30,3) ki havvav yaggid hitkashsherut hannosaf im harishon, vechesron havvav yaggid ki hu gevul bifne atzmo. umizze naskil al kol davar vedavar venelech leyashshev kol perat uferat bimkomo, veze yatza rishona benidvat hammishkan: amar 6 berosh kol perat kede lehasemich ulehashvot kol hayg devarim, lomar shekkullam shavim likkarot terumat Adonai uzechutan shava, mevi hannechoshet kemevi zahav, kemo shemmatzinu sheamar hakkatuv beolat habbehema "reach nichoach" uveolat haof "reach nichoach", veamru zichronam livracha (menachot 110,1) lomar lecha echad hammarbe veechad hammamit vechulei, veayyen ma shepperashti bainyan befarashat vayyikra (Vayikra 1,17).

Gam nitkavven lomar shekkol hayg devarim chova hem letzarche hammishkan, davar katan kedavar gadol meakkevin, asher al ken chibberam bemachberet havvavin. kol ze beerech davar hannittan, aval beerech hannaase mimmennu yesh bahem haderagot hakkedushsha, kamma kedushshot hem zo lemala mizzo, velo tidme shum kedushsha lema shelmala mimmenna.

rashi: (Al hannashim. im hannashim usemuchin alehen):
Chach. hu tachshit shel zahav agol, natun al hazzeroa, vehu hatztzamid:
Vechumaz. keli zahav hu natun keneged oto makom laishsha, verabbotenu pershu shem kumaz, kan mekom zimma (shabbat 64):
ohc: Vayyavou haanashim al hannashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro al hannashim. od, lamma kafal lomar paam acheret kol nediv lev. veulay ki yodia hakkatuv ofen nidvat lev asher asu anshe hachayil, ki davar yadua hu sheyyesh haderagot beahavat hannechasim, vehem arba: harishona shebbarishonot hem kele tachshite bene veto shel adam uchele habbayit, devarim ellu yigdal erkam beene haadam mikkol kinyan kaspo, vehaddavar pashut hu. sheniyya – hazzahav, ki mikkol kinyanim sheyyeshnam baolam yohav hazzahav yoter mikkullam. shelishit – devarim sheenam benimtza zulat etzlo, yigdal maalatam beenav yoter mishshiur shavyam. reviit – hem shear kinyene haadam, kesef usheve kesef.

Vesidder hakkatuv haderagot hammitnaddevim baam, verishon bakkodesh hitchil bo veamar vayyavou haanashim al hannashim, perush, ma sheal hannashim kol nediv lev heviu otam. vesidder hakkatuv hattachshitim sheheviu lehareot chibbat hammitnaddevim, shello ratzu lehavi ella davar hayyoter meulle vechaviv etzlam, hagam sheomdim lishvira ulekalkel, af al pi chen ahava nafsham chibbat hakkodesh mikkol yekar raata enam, veheviu kol tachshite neshehem chach vanezem vetabbaat vegomer. vedikdek lomar nediv lev, da ki yesh hefresh ben yiddevennu libbo lindiv lev, ki yiddevennu libbo yeamer al kol asher yitnaddev millibbo, veyesh sheyyiddevennu harebe veyesh sheyyiddevennu meat, aval nediv lev yeamer al lev nadiv, vehu haramuz beamro asher nesao libbo, ki mi shellibbo nadiv yitnaddev yoter mehayyecholet velo yakpid al hachesron asher yimtzaennu, ki sameach bannetina yoter mehakkinyan etzlo. veamro kol keli zahav, perush, lo tomar ki letzad shehayu lahem hattachshitin hu sheheviu laAdonai hakkefel, laze amar kol keli zahav shello hinnichu lahem keli zahav. veamro chach vanezem shem hammin. o yirtze kol keli zahav lomar shello hinnichu bevetam kol min keli zahav shebbahem yishtaashea adam, lekayyem amro (Shir HaShirim 1:4) "nagila venismecha bach". veulay ki ramaz beamro al hannashim shehevium alehem, uvevoah lifne moshe horidu edyam mealehem unetanum litrumat Adonai, chibba yetera nodaat lahem baze laadonenu baruch hu.

Haderaga sheniyya hi hazzahav sheeno asuy tachshit, keneged hammevi mibbechina zo amar vechol ish asher henif tenufat zahav laAdonai. shelishit devarim sheenam benimtza, ki hayu vammidbar veen sham benimtza techelet veargaman vechulei, ucheneged hammevi mehem amar vechol ish asher vegomer techelet veargaman vegomer. reviit vehu madrega shellematta mikkullan bivchinat hakkinyanim kesef usheve kesef, amar kol merim terumat kesef unechoshet vegomer.

Veamro vechol asher nimtza itto atze shittim, ellu en lahem kinnuy nedava, vehattaam al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, teruma) ki tzafa yaakov avinu vechulei tzivva unetaum letzarche hammishkan, velaze lo amar ella vechol asher nimtza itto atze shittim vegomer heviu, vedikdek lomar lechol melechet haavoda letzaddek devarenu, ki metziat atze shittim beyadam haya letzarche melechet hammishkan, sheim lo chen lo haya tzarich lomar ken, veod haya lo lehakedim lomar heviu veachar kach yomar lechol melechet hammishkan, ella lomar ki metziutam beyadam hu limlechet vegomer vehem lo asu ella hahavaa vahave kedavar sheen bo chesron kis lahem, vehaven. ulefi ma shehitztzanu yesh taam nachon lamma amar bechol perat uferat "heviu" velo hispik beachat, ki en haderagat hahavaa shava.

rashi: Leummat kale hechatzer. kemiddat kale hechatzer:
Lo tevaaru esh. yesh merabbotenu omrim haveara lelav yatzat, veyesh omrim lechallek yatzat (shabbat 70):

Vehannesiim heviu. amar Rabbi natan: ma rau nesiim lehitnaddev bachanukkat hammizbeach battechilla uvimlechet hammishkan lo hitnaddevu battechilla? ella kach amru nesiim, yitnaddevu tzibbur ma shemmitnaddevin, uma shemmechasserim, anu mashlimin oto, kevan shehishlimu tzibbur et hakkol – shenne vehammelacha hayta dayyam – amru nesiim me alenu laasot? heviu et avne hashshoham vegomer, lechach hitnaddevu bachanukkat hammizbeach techilla, ulefi shennitatztzelu mittechilla nechsera ot mishshemam, vehannesiim ketiv (sifre Bamidbar 45):
ohc: Vehannesiim vegomer. letzad shebbau baacharona, nichtevu achar matve haizzim bechachmat nashim.

rashi: Mayim amukkim etza velev ish. halacha belev chacham setuma:
Veish tevuna yidlenna. vetalmid navon ba vedala otah mimmeav:
targum: Maya amike etzta velibba degavra vegavra demitbayen nidlinah:

ohc: Vayyetzu kol adat bene yisrael. perush, sheyyatzu kullam keechad bizrizut lehavi, velo haya bahem echad shennitakkev mechavero.

Millifne moshe. perush millefanav, kodem sheyyitten lahem reshut laamod millefanav, vahagam deamrinan beyoma (53,1) sheen reshut letalmid laamod millifne rabbo ella ad sheyyitten lo reshut, danu yisrael ki kesheamar lahem "kechu meittechem teruma" vegomer vegamar devarav keillu amar lahem amodu. o efshar ki ahavat haddavar kilkela hashshura. od nire shennitkavvenu lehakedim leval yelech moshe veyakdim lehavi kol hatztzorech mishshello, ki ashir gadol haya vecheshek gadol hu baasot mitzvot Adonai, laze yatzu millefanav, perush, al derech amro (Rut 4:7) "vezot lefanim", kodem lo.

rashi: Taavat adam chasdo. ikkar shehabberiyyot mitavvim laadam baavur chasdo:
Vetov rash meish kazav. veim ish kazav hu umavtiach veeno ose, tov ish rash mimmennu:
targum: Ragteh devar nasha chasdeh vetav miskena min gavra chadava:

rashi: Et ammudav veet adaneha. hare chatzer karuy kan leshon zachar uleshon nekeva, vechen devarim harebe:

Veet masach shaar hechatzer. vilon parus letzad hammizrach esrim amma emtzaiyyot shel rochav hechatzer – shehaya chamishshim rochav – usetumin hemennu letzad tzafon 15 amma, vechen laddarom, shenneemar, vachamesh esre amma kelaim lakkatef:
Ra ra yomar hakkone. hakkone tora al yede haddechak veyissure reavon, omer: oy li al raa zot vehatztzara hazzot. uchesheholech lo male chachma az yithallal al hatztzaar shennitztaer:
Veozel lo. veholech lo:
targum: Chavra lechavreh nemar diknit vehedin nishtabbach venemar:

rashi: Sheshet yamim. hikdim lahem azharat shabbat letziuuy melechet hammishkan, lomar sheeno doche et hashshabbat (mechilta):
ohc: Sheshet yamim tease. taam zichron asiyyat melacha bime hachol, ulay sheyyechavven lomar sheim yihye yom shevii kodesh, tease hammelacha hatztzericha lecha besheshet yamim.

O yirtze hakkatuv leesor melechet shabbat ben al yede atzmo ben al yede goy, vehu amro sheshet yamim tease betzeri tachat hattav, perush tihye naaset, aval bayyom hashshevii afillu al yede acherim en lecha laasot, veze kehaomer amira legoy asura devar tora (mechilta parashat ba). vetaam amro sheshet velo besheshet kede shello tite ki yesh mitzva baasiyyat melacha bahem.

Od yirmoz ki lo yakumu sheshet yamim bimlachtam asher hechinam Adonai laasot, ella im yom hashshevii yihye lachem kodesh, aval im lo yishmeru shabbat lo yihyu hashsheshet yamim, ki shabbat hu nefesh kiyyum haolam, uchemo shehikdamnu befarashat bereshit beferush pasuk (Bereshit 2:2) "vaychal vegomer bayyom hashshevii" yeuyyan sham.

rashi: Naham kakkefir emat melech mitabbero. mechaaso:
targum: Naham hech arya emta demalka uman demachamet leh chate al nafsheh:

ohc: Al tzalot haaron. shalosh peamim nizkar haaron befarasha zo, keneged shelosha aronot sheasa betzalel, keamram zichronam livracha (yoma av:).

rashi: Arev laish lechem shaker. niuf eshet ish:
Veachar yimmale fihu chatzatz. avanim dakkot, vechen "vayyagres bechatzatz" (Eicha 3:16):
targum: Ariv legavra velachma ragala uvata heden nitmele pumeh chatzatza:
